facts.summary: Phase 2 combination trial missed efficacy endpoints, drug well tolerated · Phase 2 · ELX-02 in Class 1 cystic fibrosis · not yet approved

evidence.summary: The combination trial of ELX-02 with ivacaftor was well tolerated but did not achieve statistical significance for efficacy endpoints, including changes from baseline in sweat chloride concentration (SCC) and percent forced expiratory volume (FEV1).
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: Overall, the study did not achieve statistical significance for efficacy endpoints in the Phase 2 study in Class 1 CF for efficacy endpoints, including changes from baseline in SCC and FEV1.
evidence.safety: ELX-02 was generally well tolerated in the trial, with no treatment-related serious adverse events noted.
evidence.program_discontinued: Path forward for ELX-02 for the treatment of Class 1 CF to be determined together with CF Foundation
